symptom: describe page -> exec on a Studio Pro-built project rewrote Forms$LayoutGridColumn.PreviewWidth from a stored 1 to -1 (ako/mxcli-ledger FINDINGS #170)
cause: layoutGridColumnToGen hardcodes SetPreviewWidth(-1) and nothing carried the stored value; PreviewWidth is a Studio Pro editor-canvas value with no MDL spelling
insight: The hardcode matched 731 of 732 stored columns in TestApp+PedApp, so a fixture sweep never showed it; one real project did. A nameless element is carried by position inside its nearest named ancestor (grid name, row i, column j), and only when the stored row has the same column count, so an edited row falls back to the new-column default instead of mispairing. Set only a differing value: an equal set dirties a kept element (#721 L4).
